capabilities: capture fleeting notes with a quick-capture modal
create literature notes with author, year, and quotes
promote fleeting notes to permanent or literature notes
generate timestamp-based Zettel IDs in a configurable format
process unprocessed notes from an inbox sidebar view
extras: The manifest carries the marketplace note that the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in structure for the Zettelkasten method's note types, Zettel IDs, or an inbox for processing raw captures.
summary: Zettelkasten workflow system that manages fleeting, literature, and permanent atomic notes with timestamp IDs and an inbox view.
